name: varg-unboxing-video
description: Turns product photos into an unboxing or ASMR video ad on varg: hands-only, top-down or POV, the box tapped, opened and the product lifted out and switched on, with native ASMR sound (taps, crinkle, lid pop) and no music, in timed VISUAL / ACTION / SOUND blocks on Seedance 2.5 with the box and the product as references. Unboxing has the highest winner rate of any Meta ad format (9.8%, Motion 2026) while only 2.1% of ads use it. Use when a seller (TikTok Shop, Shopify, dropshipping, Amazon) asks for an unboxing video, an ASMR or satisfying product video, "open the box" content, a packaging reveal, or a hands-only product demo made from photos. Not for talking-head UGC (use ai-ugc-ad-video), the full 60 s guide reel (varg-dropship-reel) or a studio spin of the product alone (product-photo-to-video).
